planComparison: The original frozen seven-line CAP-1 plan remains intact and IN_PROGRESS: zero complete original subsections and no independent provider/client/released acceptance. Against merged main 69c46b71b6ab35e483f42338618146d1a377d074, the draft implements a source-only deterministic 209-row inventory: 163 pinned vendored Neon REST methods, 193 independently byte-verified official SDK operations (162 shared, 31 SDK-only, 1 vendor-only), 17 declared shared wire differences, and 15 separate advanced-host workflows. Parsed literal provider-call sites replace module-wide false handler attribution; six credential classes retain proven/unsupported/unknown rather than unverified broad rights. Installed SDK 7.0.1 fake transport proof covers 159 exact raw HTTP method/path/budget routes, 4 declared fallback stubs, 31 fail-closed missing generic dispatch paths, 159 sanitized simulated HTTP 403 denials, and 94 non-replayed simulated HTTP 503 mutations; these are not user/provider permissions. Actual shared source correctness defects were fixed: ambiguous project writes can no longer be falsely confirmed using an unrelated branch annotation; only createProjectBranch may use that specific recovery. The durable DB budget and SDK wrapper now require explicit boolean admission; invalid/throwing results refuse provider HTTP with sanitized 503 and explicit denial is bounded 429. Operation-specific fake tests, strict source-pin/contract/negative validation, checked artifacts, card/owner/architecture/status/decision/audit records and real isolated PostgreSQL budget regressions support this source stage. Final local npm run check PASS, 1,114/1,114 unit tests (155 files) and 125/125 disposable PostgreSQL tests (48 files) PASS. Required exact-head GitHub CI and independent real provider authorization, registered tool policy/readback for every operation, current comprehensive external interfaces and deployed direct-client acceptance remain separate. CAP-2/CAP-3 and all CG gates remain open; no live resource, key, production database, paid action, issuer or deployment was changed.
